top_signals.summary: Politics, Geopolitics & Conflict Baghdad has ordered a federal takeover of Kurdish oil exports, border crossings and the oilfields under Kurdish security control, and Iraq's Federal Supreme Court has ruled that borders, customs and oversight of oil exports belong to the federal government. top_signals.title: Stockpiling Will Support Oil Prices in 2027, Energy Aspects Says
top_signals.summary: Depleted inventories are setting the stage for a major stockpiling push next year, which will support oil prices despite an expected market surplus, Energy Aspect’s founder and director Amrita Sen told Bloomberg TV in an interview on Friday. China will lead the global stockpiling in the coming months, as it typically does when oil prices fall. top_signals.title: The Next Hormuz?
top_signals.summary: The approach to the Bab el-Mandeb, the chokepoint at the southern end of the Red Sea, is fast becoming the next Hormuz or Yemen, with Turkey and the UAE building rival military positions along Somalia's coast.
